questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an essential element required for the formation of a legally valid contract?
questions.explain: For a contract to be valid and legally binding, there must be an **offer, acceptance, consideration, intention to create legal relations**, and **capacity** to contract. Registration with a commercial bank is not a legal requirement for a general contract.

questions.q: A contract is said to be discharged by **frustration** when...
options: one party completely performs their obligations ahead of time.
an unforeseen event beyond the control of both parties makes performance impossible.
one party outrightly refuses to perform their part of the agreement.
both parties mutually agree to cancel the original agreement.
questions.explain: Discharge by **frustration** occurs when an unexpected event (like a natural disaster, a new government law making the act illegal, or destruction of the subject matter) makes it impossible to perform the contract.
